name: lilymap
description: A local Hugo workspace for the lily-epitaph theme.

scripts.check: node --check server.mjs && node --check public/js/app.js && node --check public/js/core/api.js && node --check public/js/core/dom.js && node --check public/js/core/state.js && node --check public/js/core/icons.js && node --check public/js/core/studio.js && node --check public/js/features/module-library.js && node --check public/js/features/music-module.js && node --check public/js/features/module-installer.js
scripts.exe: npm run build && pkg --config package.json server.cjs --targets=node22-win-x64 --output=dist/LilyMap.exe
